tei:div.tei:p: (ka)༄// zhang ston la bstod pa bzhugs// ༄༅// bla ma dam pa rnams la mgos phyag 'tshal// yon tan mchog mnga' gzhan la phan pa'i thugs rje can// ting 'dzin mchog brnyes nyid kyi don yang mthar phyin pa// dam pa mchog chos don gnyis grub pas mngon shes dang*// rdzu 'phrul mchog 'bar sbas pa'i brtul zhugs can la 'dud// rab mchog gyur pa mthu stobs dbang phyug man ngag gis// grub pa'i dbang phyug dam par gyur pa'i bla ma mchog /zab lam chos kyis skal ldan mchog tu tshim mdzad pa// 'bar ba'i mtshan can yid kyi mun sel khyed la 'dud// spangs rtogs mthar phyin mdzad pa mtha' yas longs spyod rdzogs// rdo rje'i tshig rnams rgya cher 'grel mdzad sdud pa por// nges par mchis kyang mi yi gzugs 'dzin bla ma mchog /snyan brgyud bzhi ston yid kyi dpal gyur khyod la bstod// rang gis spyad pa'i las las gyur pa g.yo ba yi// nad kyis btab pa khyod kyi thugs rjes zil mnan nas// rmongs par gyur pa ye shes chen po'i ros gang ba// rnal 'byor dbang phyug khyed kyi mthu yis rjes su skyongs// dag pa rang bzhin dag pa'i mthu yis bla ma la// rnam grol thob phyir rnam par mi rtog pa nyid du// dad pa chen pos dad pa'i shugs kyis gsol 'debs na// thugs rje chen pos thugs rje'i lcags kyus gzung du gsol// rje btsun bla ma dam pa la gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshig sa māpta mi thi/ rje dgon pa bas zab don gyi byin rlabs stsal ba'i tshe/ bla ma sa chen gyis bstod pa'o// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
